scenes.title: Title
scenes.purpose: Promise a warm, simple recipe; establish the page, the ink line and the pan that will cook through the film.
on_screen_text: Spiced milk tea for two, in about ten minutes.
scenes.visual: Copy column with the title card; the saucepan is already on the page (thumbnail-safe first frame) and steam draws itself, then breathes.

layout.portrait: Pan in the upper half, title below

beats.action: Title lines rise; underline draws under 'chai'
Steam draws, then breathes until the wipe

transition_out.continuity: The pan stays on the page; only the copy column turns.

scenes.title: Ingredients
scenes.purpose: Everything needed for two cups, scannable at a glance.
scenes.visual: Itemised list with quantities; cardamom pods and ginger slices assemble around the pan; a slow camera push begins.

layout.landscape: One-column list left of the pan

transition_out.continuity: Rows exit upward; the drawing is untouched.

scenes.title: Step 1: crush
scenes.purpose: Show that whole spices are crushed, not ground, before cooking.
on_screen_text: Lightly crush the cardamom and ginger to release their oils.
scenes.visual: Pods and ginger squash with a short burst of seeded specks, then drop into the pan.

transition_out.continuity: Copy changes in place over the persistent pan.

scenes.title: Step 2: simmer
scenes.purpose: Water goes in and the spices simmer; show heat and time without a timer graphic.
on_screen_text: Simmer the spices in the water for two minutes.
scenes.visual: Water rises inside the pan (morphing surface), the burner flames appear and flicker, bubbles rise.

transition_out.continuity: Same pan, same water; the copy changes.

scenes.title: Step 3: tea and milk
scenes.purpose: Tea leaves brew, then milk turns the brew into chai.
on_screen_text: Brew the tea for a minute. Add the milk; bring to a boil.
scenes.visual: Tea leaves fall in and the water turns amber; a milk stream draws down, the liquid turns caramel and rises.

transition_out.continuity: The chai itself rises to fill the frame and drains to reveal the glass.

scenes.title: Step 4: strain and serve
scenes.purpose: The payoff: a glass of chai.
on_screen_text: Strain into two cups. Sweeten to taste.
scenes.visual: A cutting-chai glass draws in ink, fills with caramel colour, steam draws and breathes.

transition_out.continuity: The glass becomes the end card's mark, moving from the art panel to the centre.

scenes.title: End
scenes.purpose: Close warmly and hold long enough to read.
scenes.visual: Glass mark above the closing title; held to the end.
